displayDescription: Navy halftone comic: a bulb clicks on, a spark leaps the gutter, and a node network inks on under concentration lines.
styleRenderer: Rough.js (seeded burst, rays, stamp keylines, spark trail, network edges and nodes)
motionEngine: Motion (interpolate/easing utilities evaluate every pose from composition time)
GSAP (single paused timeline as the seekable HyperFrames clock only)
audioDescription: Silent. No audio track, music, effects or voice.
limitations: The halftone is a procedural SVG dot-pattern approximation of single-ink print. It has no registration error, ink spread or paper fibre.
Rough.js lines are seeded and static, so there is no line boil. They approximate inked contours and are not hand drawing.
PixiJS was reviewed but not used, because the scene has few sprites and SVG covers it.

Lettering uses OS-bundled macOS Impact and Comic Sans MS (with Chalkboard SE/Chalkboard as fallbacks), declared through @font-face local() rules. These are system stand-ins for hand lettering, and output depends on the render host having these fonts.
Background evidence comes from one source contact sheet with 8 sampled seconds. The source subject, branding and wording were not copied.
